scenario: Length is codepoint count per LSTR.9.2 — `len(s)` returns the number of Unicode codepoints. Pin: `len(m.text) == 5` in a where clause compiles OK.
rules_ds:
schema Msg scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    text: String mutable

rule r:
    Msg m where len(m.text) == 5
->
    log info "five codepoints"
